rationale.conceptual: Standard method (DFT-LDA with norm-conserving pseudopotentials, equation-of-state fitting, DFPT phonons) applied without modification. The only nuance is selecting appropriate pseudopotentials and convergence parameters, which is routine for anyone familiar with DFT.
